_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Joueur Snake kwa {width}×{height} grid.
Oyo uzali snake {player_id}. Mikono isyo na maana: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (au w/s/a/d).
Objectif: kukwama mrefu zaidi au kuwa mrefu zaidi na kupata alama ya juu zaidi (kikomo cha mzunguko {max_turns} mizunguko).

board.after_moves: Etúká ya Conseil oyo ezali na mikolo: {board}

game_action.invalid_death: Nyoka {player_id} akufaki mpo na kobaluka ya mabe.

outcome.all_dead_simul: Nyoka nyonso ekufaki na mbala moko.
outcome.outlived: Mosani oyo alekaki bato mosusu nyonso na bomoi.
outcome.turn_limit: Soki ndelo ya bapoti ekomi, moto oyo azwi mingi koleka akozwa esika na bango.
